metadata.description: Plugins maintained by Denha Nexus s.r.o. for paid advertising work.

plugins.name: ad-spec-guard
plugins.description: Verified specifications and decision thresholds for paid advertising: platform character limits, creative dimensions, statistical gates before pausing or scaling a campaign, UTM tagging and policy pre-checks.

plugins.name: adsbeast
plugins.description: Work with your own ADS Beast advertising workspace: account audits, wasted spend, tracking and budget checks, platform comparison, leads with attribution, and campaign changes that run only from a stored preview and wait for a person's approval. Twelve workflow skills. Requires an ADS Beast account and a scoped API key.
